title: Disciplinary powers of Bar Council of India.―(1) Where on receipt of a complaint or otherwise the
text:
36. Disciplinary powers of Bar Council of India.―(1) Where on receipt of a complaint or otherwise the

Bar Council of India has reason to believe that any advocate whose name is not entered on any State roll
has been guilty of professional or other misconduct, it shall refer the case for disposal to its disciplinary
committee.
